Interface RmiClientRemote

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
RmiServerProxy
public interface RmiClientRemote extends Remote
RMI remote interface exposed by the client to the server. Each method mirrors a VirtualView notification, with the addition of RemoteException required by RMI.

      void notifyUsernameResult(String username, boolean isValid, String reason) throws RemoteException

      Parameters:
      username - the requested username
      isValid - true if the username was accepted

      void notifyBoardUpdated(List<String> newUpperRow, List<String> newLowerRow, List<String> discardedCards, List<String> movedToLowerRow, int deckRemainingCount) throws RemoteException

      RemoteException - if the RMI call fails
